comparison.objective: Open a stiff sliding window using its delicate handle without tearing it off.
comparison.physical_skill: Force-limited handle grasping, sustained traction, friction overcoming, and possible regrasping.
comparison.success_condition: Up to full credit at 150 mm handle-driven sash travel; any handle detachment or glass/frame damage zeros the score. Later versions restrict credit to travel caused by a valid handle grasp.
comparison.reason: Force-limited prismatic actuation through a fragile handle is unrelated to granular screening.
